identityRule: Sorted path + NUL + lowercase SHA256 + newline; candidate content/puzzles.json uses the exact review input override, all other files use current worktree bytes.

contentOverride.preservation: Exact current first_principles object; HEAD prefix and remainder byte-identical. Review input is not a shipped second source.
